cfo_chris: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands finance segment. Short Q&A on Q2 spend guardrails and procurement exceptions.

sara_fpna: Thanks Chris. For hiring requests already approved, do spend controls retroactively apply?

cfo_chris: No. Hiring authorizations signed before today's memo are honored. New reqs need the updated justification form.

devon_eng: On procurement exceptions: who can greenlight a one-off tool purchase under $12k?

kevin_procurement: For <$5k manager ok; $5k-$15k requires manager + procurement signoff. Exceptions for time-sensitive infra can be escalated to on-call finance for verbal approval.

lina_hr: Training budgets question: will individual learning credits be frozen? We have onboarding courses scheduled.

cfo_chris: Onboarding essentials stay. Individual discretionary credits paused for Q2 unless pre-approved by manager and FP&A.

finance_bot: [Automated] Spend guardrails summary: /docs/finance/q2-guardrails-summary.pdf

sara_fpna: Can FP&A publish a simple one-pager with the approval matrix and contact points? Helps managers triage.

cfo_chris: Yes, Sara will send a one-pager today.

devon_eng: If a team hits a cloud spend spike due to CI flakiness, is there a fast appeals channel?

kevin_procurement: Use urgent procurement path: tag #eng-oncall, email procurement@ with [URGENT-SPEND] and copy on-call finance. We aim to respond within 24-48 hours. Retro report required.

lina_hr: Will there be any change to vendor background checks for small contractors?

cfo_chris: Security/legal still required for anyone with customer-data access. Procurement will add a quick checklist for contractors under $10k.

sara_fpna: One more: chargebacks for reserved Dedicated capacity 9 how will teams be notified?

cfo_chris: Reservation tagging is mandatory. Finance will surface weekly reservation charge estimates in Console.

kevin_procurement: I'll publish the updated procurement template and an example by EOD.

finance_bot: [Automated] Follow-up doc: /internal/finance/all-hands-quick-actions-1803001234.md

cfo_chris: TL;DR actions: 1) Sara: one-pager approval matrix (today). 2) Kevin: updated template + example (EOD). 3) Finance: reservation tagging and weekly view (1 week).

devon_eng: Thanks, that helps.

lina_hr: Appreciated.

cfo_chris: Thanks everyone  open to 1:1s if there are edge cases.
